name: v1.10.2
body:
Security fix for CVE-2026-111943 (the eMudhra private keys)

## What's Changed
* ci: Use a composite result for e2e tests (cherry-pick #4843 for 1.10) by @argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot] in https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/pull/5164
* test: do not hit the Github API in flaky test (cherry-pick #5158 for 1.10) by @argo-cd-cherry-pick-bot[bot] in https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/pull/5163
* chore: bump golang to 1.26.10 (cherry-pick #5156 for 1.10) by @kostis-codefresh in https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/pull/5161


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2
